verbatim_locator: Legend: "The semitransparent rectangle indicates the therapeutic range of ETX concentrations. Each symbol is mean ± SEM, n = 6 to 19." Discussion: "the G βγ -activated GIRK1/2 (the predominant GIRK composition in the brain) shows EC 50 of ~1 mM; thus, approximately 30–50% of G βγ -activated GIRK1/2 channels, and all G βγ -activated GIRK2 channels in neurons may be inhibited by the higher therapeutic doses of ETX (0.7–1.1 mM)."
what_the_image_shows: GIRK2+GbetaK78R (orange) crosses 50 percent at about 0.03 mM, GIRK2+GbetaWT (blue) at about 0.06 mM; both are at 85-90 percent inhibition across the shaded band (about 0.25 to 0.9 mM by eye; ranking README labelled range 283-708 uM). GIRK1/2 alone (black) crosses at about 3 mM, to the right of the band. Two curves the proposition omits: GIRK1/2+GbetaWTgamma (red) about 1 mM, GIRK1/2+GbetaK78Rgamma (green) about 0.4-0.5 mM, both crossing inside or at the upper edge of the band.
caveat_or_change: CHANGES the quantitative statement: the 0.03-0.06 mM crossings are 4-8x BELOW the lower edge of the band, not inside it; GIRK2 homomer block is near-saturating at labelled exposure. But the brain-predominant GIRK1/2 heteromer with Gbg is only partly blocked in the band (about 20-60 percent), and GIRK2 homomer abundance in neurons is stated by the authors to be unknown. Wild-type and K78R curves similar (K78R slightly left): "not mutant-specific" holds. Oocyte data, not neurons, no WWOX.

Read-out limit: stars are genotype contrasts at each time (t-test per time point), there is no within-genotype drug test and no drug-by-genotype term; the WT arm sits at about 3 or less, so a WT drug effect is not measurable (floor). what_the_image_shows: b: NEC about -21 at -55 to -45 mV, GAERS about -16, stars -60 to -40 mV, Z944 curve about -1.5. c: GAERS about -34 vs NEC about -29 at -10 to 0 mV (stars). e: about 1.6 vs 1.2, TWO stars (text says p < 0.001). g: about 3.7 vs 1.7, three stars; blot lanes NEC 3, GAERS 4. a: burst in control trace, none with Z944 at the pulse offset.
caveat_or_change: No change to the proposition. Qualifiers to carry: (i) the current is from P7-P9 neurons, the mRNA and protein reduction is adult (P9 mRNA not different), so "T-type current smaller" is an early-postnatal measurement and "Cav3.1 lower" an adult one; (ii) panel e shows two stars where the text gives p < 0.001; (iii) mRNA/protein are not function. Direction (smaller, not larger, T-type current in a model whose seizures ethosuximide treats) is confirmed.

verbatim_locator: Results: "in the presence of ZD7288, both P15–P20 and adult GAERS VB neurons no longer required a greater magnitude current injection to burst-fire compared to NEC VB neurons, indicating that I h is indeed responsible for the suppressed burst-firing observed in GAERS (Fig. 6b )". Legend: "adult (NEC ( n = 28 ...), GAERS ( n = 17 ...)) and P15–P20 (NEC ( n = 7), GAERS ( n = 8))".
what_the_image_shows: b: with ZD7288 thresholds positive: P15-P20 about +30 (NEC) and +38 (GAERS), adult about +59 and +62, no star; control bars about -30/-41 (*) and -33/-57 (*). c: about 4 spikes per burst all groups. d: Rin similar with ZD7288 (no star; trend lower in GAERS). e: Vrest about -90 mV.
caveat_or_change: No change. Qualifier: ZD7288 hyperpolarises to about -90 mV and flips the threshold sign, and the authors state that restoring the control resting potential failed ("most neurons would not maintain a steady membrane potential"); the convergence is therefore under an altered state and "Ih is responsible" is the authors' inference, not an isolated manipulation. Panel b controls also confirm the 1000 ms thresholds of entry 9 (about -30/-41 and -33/-57), not counted as an audit of entry 9.

caveat_or_change: Star and P = 0.042 read correctly. "remains lost" overstates: the plotted triple mean is positive (about 0.2) against about 0.3, the star comes from a Fisher exact (categorical) test at n = 12 vs 22, and it is a single borderline value. Carry it as a borderline genetic result, not as a second independent confirmation of entry 18.
